checks.item: Minimum wage 2026: full-time annual gross and arithmetic
checks.researched: 57,672 zł = 4,806 zł a month x 12 (31.40 zł an hour); no legal 13th or 14th month in the private sector
checks.verified: 57,672 zł. 4,806 x 12 = 57,672. Council of Ministers regulation of 11 Sep 2025: 4,806 zł a month and 31.40 zł an hour from 1 Jan 2026, one rate for the whole year (no mid-year change). GUS March 2026 first decile of all monthly pay is exactly 4,806 zł. GUS lists the annual additional salary (13th) only for budget-sector units.
checks.note: Exact legal figure. In March 2026 GUS counts 1.507 million employees (12.2%) paid at or below the minimum (Tabl. 17).

checks.item: Driving licence age (car licence without a supervising driver)
checks.researched: 17 (gov.pl lists category B = 17; the researcher's note says the page mentions no supervision requirement)
checks.verified: 17 is only the age at which a restricted, accompanied licence can be obtained (in force since 3 Mar 2026). Dz.U. 2025 poz. 1676 sets the statutory minimum age for category B at 17 (art. 8 ust. 1 pkt 3), but the new art. 8a says a B licence obtained after 17 and before 18 entitles you to drive only (1) on Polish territory until you turn 18 and (2) with a front-seat passenger aged 25+ who has held category B for 5+ years, has no driving ban in the last 5 years and is sober, for 6 months from the day of issue and in any case no longer than until the 18th birthday. So solo driving starts at 17.5 at the very earliest, and an unrestricted licence only at 18.
checks.source: https://www.dziennikustaw.gov.pl/D2025000167601.pdf (art. 4 pkt 4 and 5, art. 22: in force 3 months after publication on 2 Dec 2025) ; https://www.gov.pl/web/infrastruktura/uwaga-kierowcy--od-3-marca-obowiazuja-nowe-przepisy---sprawdz-co-sie-zmienilo ; https://biz.prawko.pl/portal/blog/prawo-jazdy-od-17-lat-kiedy-mozna-jezdzic-bez-opiekuna/ ; https://www.gov.pl/web/gov/kategorie-prawa-jazdy
checks.note: Under the spec definition (licence without a supervising driver) use 18. The gov.pl category page (updated 09.07.2026) says '17 lat' and the Poland-only limit, and the extract I retrieved shows no accompanying-passenger rule, but the law itself has one, so the researcher's inference that there is no supervision requirement is wrong. If the game wants to model the accompanied licence, 17 is acceptable only if flagged as supervised for the first 6 months.

checks.item: Public-university bachelor tuition a domestic full-time student pays
checks.researched: 0 zł in all three tiers (admission fee 85 zł per application, student ID 22 zł once)
checks.verified: 0 zł tuition for full-time first-, second- and long-cycle study in Polish at public universities for Polish citizens (Eurydice, page dated 21 Sep 2026). Remaining charges: recruitment fee 85 zł (100 zł where an entrance exam is held; UJ 2026/27), plastic student ID 22 zł (mobile ID free), record book 4 zł.
checks.note: About 63% of students study full-time (804k of 1,280k, Dec 2024, GUS); the other ~37% study part-time and pay tuition (next line).

checks.item: Part-time (evening or weekend) bachelor tuition at a public university
checks.researched: Not quantified (the notes only say fees are charged for part-time study)
checks.verified: Qualitative claim confirmed. 2026/27 examples: University of Bialystok first-cycle 6,500-7,400 zł a year (economics 6,500, administration 7,400), second-cycle 6,300-7,400; Warsaw University of Technology, Faculty of Mechanical Engineering, 6,210 zł per semester = 12,420 zł a year. UJ publishes part-time fees only in its study catalogue (annual fee paid in 8 instalments).
checks.note: If the game needs one number for a fee-paying student at a public university, about 7,000-12,000 zł a year. Private universities charge in every mode: first-year ranges roughly 3,400-21,100 zł for economics and 3,800-17,300 for law (otouczelnie.pl).

checks.researched: 0 zł (state-funded full-time places)
checks.verified: 0 zł for full-time, Polish-language medicine at a public university for Polish citizens (Eurydice: no tuition in full-time long-cycle programmes). Fee-paying places exist beside them (next two lines).

checks.researched: 26,000 zł a semester (Gdansk Medical University, from a press report)

checks.verified: Matches the press report (o2.pl, 2026/27): Andrzej Frycza Modrzewski University 60,000-64,000 a year, 372,000 for the cycle; Lazarski University 37,000-46,000 per semester, 494,000 for the cycle. 372,000/6 = 62,000; 37,000-46,000 x 2 = 74,000-92,000 a year.

checks.researched: 0 zł in all tiers
checks.verified: 0 zł: public universities charge no tuition in full-time first-, second- and long-cycle programmes and full-time doctoral programmes; law is a long-cycle programme.

checks.researched: 0 zł (public post-secondary vocational schools charge no fee)

checks.item: Secondary-school teacher typical annual gross (mid-scale)
checks.verified: About 118,000-123,000 zł. 2026 Teachers' Charter average pay including allowances: beginning 6,824, appointed 8,061, chartered 10,300 zł a month (3% raise from 1 Jan 2026; base amount 5,597.87; minimum basic pay 5,272 / 5,469 / 6,397). checks.item: Resident physician typical annual gross
checks.researched: 139,857 zł (11,654.76 x 12; priority specialty, first two years; before on-call duty pay)
checks.verified: 139,857 zł is exactly the statutory base for a priority-specialty resident in years 1-2 from 1 Jul 2026 (Minister of Health regulation of 25 Jun 2026, Dz.U. 2026 poz. 856). Whole scale: 127,143 (other specialties, years 1-2) to 152,571 (priority, after year 2). Cross-checks: AOTMiT Feb 2026 residents' average actual pay 9,797 zł a month before the July raise (about 128,000 a year after +8.8%); GUS Oct 2024 doctors (ISCO 221) first and second decile 8,763 and 10,063 a month = about 120,000-137,000 a year at 2026 level.
checks.note: Base pay only. On-call pay is extra and varies widely: a hospital-staffing website quotes 17,000-22,000 zł a month in total for duty-heavy priority residents (about 200,000-260,000 a year), and AOTMiT shows doctors without a specialisation averaging 18,355 a month including duties. If the game wants all-in pay, 150,000-200,000 is defensible but weakly sourced. Note the specialist figure (288,500) includes duty pay while this one does not.

checks.item: Specialist physician typical annual gross
checks.researched: 288,500 zł (24,044.76 x 12, AOTMiT Feb 2026 hospital average including on-call pay); legal minimum base 154,922
checks.verified: 288,537 zł = 24,044.76 x 12 (AOTMiT, 538 hospitals, Feb 2026, employed specialists, including on-call pay and seniority supplements); AOTMiT forecast after the 1 Jul 2026 raise 25,049 a month (300,600 a year). Statutory minimum base from 1 Jul 2026: 12,910.16 = 1.45 x 8,903.56 (154,922 a year).

checks.item: National median full-time annual gross wage
checks.researched: 93,000 zł (sum of 2025 monthly medians 86,956 x 1.07)
checks.verified: About 94,000-101,000 zł. GUS monthly medians (ZUS data, all employees): the twelve 2025 months sum to 86,956 (recomputed from the GUS workbooks); Q1 2026 is +7.7% on Q1 2025 (March 2026: 7,530.45, +7.6%), giving about 93,600 for 2026. GUS earnings-structure survey (employers with 10+ staff, part-time converted to full-time, 1/12 of annual bonuses included): Oct 2024 median 7,404.69; scaled by 1.138 (growth of the ZUS median from Oct 2024 to 2026E) = 8,427 a month = 101,100 a year.
checks.note: 93,000 matches the all-employee median (part-timers not converted to full-time). A strict full-time-equivalent median is about 8% higher (about 100,000); researched value is still within 15%.

checks.item: 90th-percentile full-time annual gross wage
checks.verified: About 185,000-196,000 zł. ZUS-based ninth decile: the twelve 2025 monthly values sum to 172,644 x 1.07 = 184,700; March 2026 ninth decile 15,424.85 a month (x 12 = 185,100). GUS earnings-structure survey Oct 2024 ninth decile 14,350.89 x 1.138 x 12 = 196,000.

checks.item: School-leaving qualification: name, scale, direction, pass mark
checks.researched: Matura (egzamin maturalny, świadectwo dojrzałości); each subject scored 0-100%, higher is better; pass = at least 30% in each mandatory exam; extended-level subjects have no pass mark but at least one must be taken
checks.verified: Confirmed by CKE: results are a percentage of possible points per subject (written exams also show a centile rank). To pass you must take and score at least 30% in each mandatory subject (oral Polish and oral foreign language; written Polish, mathematics and foreign language at basic level) and take at least one extended-level exam, which has no pass threshold. There is no single overall mark; certificate is the świadectwo dojrzałości.
checks.note: One search summary claimed a 30% threshold also for the extended subject; the CKE page says there is none.

checks.item: Matura 2026 results (pass rate, typical and top scores)
checks.researched: 81.1% passed (liceum 85.9%, technikum 71.3%); averages basic Polish 59%, basic maths 59%, basic English 78%, extended maths 37%; 317 of 321,314 candidates at 90-100% in every exam they took
checks.verified: All confirmed: 81.1% passed of 321,314 candidates; liceum 85.9%, technikum 71.3%, sectoral stage II schools 15.4%; basic averages 59 / 59 / 78; extended averages maths 37%, English 69%, biology 41%, chemistry 41%, physics 42%; 317 candidates scored 90-100% in all exams taken, compulsory and additional (Interia quoting CKE).
checks.note: 12.3% failed one exam and can retake it in August; 6.6% failed more than one.

checks.item: Classroom grade scale 1-6
checks.researched: Pupils are graded 1-6 (6 best, 2 is a pass, 1 a fail)
checks.verified: Six-point scale: 6 celujący, 5 bardzo dobry, 4 dobry, 3 dostateczny, 2 dopuszczający, 1 niedostateczny; 1 is the only failing grade.
checks.note: Confirmed from web-search summaries of these pages (pages not opened); no official MEN page was fetched.

checks.item: School structure and ages
checks.researched: Compulsory pre-school year at 6; 8-year primary school ages 7-15; liceum 4 years (15-19); technikum 5 years (15-20); branżowa stage I 3 years (15-18) then optional stage II 2 years; post-secondary schools 1-2.5 years; compulsory education to 18
checks.verified: Confirmed by Eurydice: pre-school obligatory at 6; 8-year primary school for ages 7-15 (grades 1-3 and 4-8); 4-year general secondary, 5-year technical, 3-year sectoral stage I and 2-year stage II; post-secondary courses of 1-2.5 years; compulsory education up to 18; Matura certificate gives access to higher education. Higher education: first cycle 3-4 years, second cycle 1.5-2, long-cycle 4-6, doctoral 3-4.
checks.note: Eurydice gives doctoral studies as 3-4 years; the researcher's 4-year doctoral school is within that.

checks.item: Exchange rate, zloty per US dollar
checks.researched: 3.8449 (NBP mid rate, 30 Sep 2026)
checks.verified: 3.8449 PLN per USD, NBP table A no. 190/A/NBP/2026 of 30 Sep 2026 (read from the NBP API). The 2026 range so far is 3.50-3.86 and the average of the 190 fixings this year is 3.68.
checks.note: The zloty has weakened from about 3.60 in January; a yearly-average rate would be about 4% stronger (3.68). The 1 Oct 2026 fixing was not yet published when checked.

checks.item: PPP conversion factor, zloty per international dollar
checks.researched: 1.97 (World Bank GDP PPP 2025 = 1.9696; household-consumption PPP 2.063)
checks.verified: World Bank PA.NUS.PPP for Poland: 2025 = 1.969559 (2024 = 1.949414); PA.NUS.PRVT.PP household consumption 2025 = 2.063158. IMF WEO implied PPP rate 2025 = 1.912 (2026 = 1.913).
checks.note: IMF figure is 3% lower than the World Bank figure; both support about 1.9-2.0.

checks.item: Student-loan nominal rate paid by the borrower
checks.researched: 1.9% (half of the 3.80% NBP rediscount rate)
checks.verified: 1.90%. Ministry of Science: during repayment the borrower pays 0.5 x the NBP bill rediscount rate; NBP rates after the 9 Sep 2026 meeting: reference 3.75%, rediscount 3.80%, so 0.5 x 3.80 = 1.90%. During payouts and the two-year grace period the state budget pays all interest.
checks.note: The researcher's alternative reading (2.3-3.3% if the student paid half of 1.2 x rediscount + margin) is not what the borrower pays: the bank's rate is margin (max 2 points) + 1.2 x rediscount and the Student Loan Fund covers the difference above the borrower's 0.5 x rediscount.

checks.item: Student-loan scheme description
checks.researched: State-guaranteed, subsidised bank loan of 400-1,000 zł a month for up to six years; state pays interest during study and a two-year grace period; repayment over twice the borrowing time; top 10% of graduates can have up to 50% cancelled
checks.verified: Confirmed: tranches of 400, 600, 800 or 1,000 zł a month, paid for up to 6 years (4 for doctoral students); state pays all interest during payouts and the grace period; repayment starts two years after graduation and runs for twice the payout period; cancellation 50% for the top 1%, 35% for 1-5%, 20% for 5-10% of graduates.
checks.note: The 35% middle band comes from student360.pl; the ministry page lists the 50% and 20% bands.

checks.item: Inflation used for the real student-loan rate
checks.researched: 4.0% (GUS flash estimate, Sep 2026)
checks.verified: 4.0% year on year and 0.7% month on month in the GUS flash estimate for September 2026; August was 3.4%. Real loan rate = 1.019/1.040 - 1 = -2.0%.
checks.note: Flash estimate; the final September figure is published mid-October.

checks.item: Living cost: gross annual pay for basic single-adult living
checks.researched: 68,000 zł (studio rent about 2,100 + bills 450 + food 1,200 + transport 130 + basics 300 = about 4,180 net a month)
checks.verified: Rent inputs confirmed: May 2026 studio rents (Otodom Analytics via Bankier) Warsaw 2,957, Kraków 2,445, Wrocław 2,386, Poznań 2,100, Łódź 1,828, Katowice 1,825. Net-to-gross conversion checked with 2026 rules (13.71% social insurance, 9% health, 12% PIT, 30,000 tax-free amount, 3,000 deductible costs): 4,180 net a month = 67,800 gross a year; 57,672 gross (minimum wage) = 3,606 net a month. Budget guides give 4,150-6,700 net a month for a single person (frugal to comfortable), rent 1,700-2,400 in mid-sized and 2,200-3,500 in large cities, food 900-1,200, bills 350-600.
checks.note: 68,000 sits at the frugal end (a modest budget in a mid-sized city); a comfortable large-city budget would be 85,000-110,000 gross. Food, transport and basics are estimates in both the research and the guides.

checks.item: Highlights (two sentences)
checks.researched: Full-time study at public universities is free, even medicine and law, and the state loan charges about 1.9% a year, below 4.0% inflation. Minimum wage 4,806 zł a month, median worker about 7,500 zł, specialist doctor's legal minimum 12,910 zł, hospital specialists average about 24,000 zł.
checks.verified: Every fact checked above: free full-time public study including medicine and law (Eurydice); loan rate 1.9% against 4.0% inflation; minimum wage 4,806; GUS median 7,530.45 (March 2026, 7,447-7,691 in Jan-Mar); specialist minimum 12,910.16; AOTMiT specialist average 24,044.76. Lengths are 159 and 179 characters, under the 200 limit.
checks.note: Highlight 1 omits that about 37% of students study part-time and pay tuition, and that paid medicine places exist.
